{{Top|leg}}
A '''guillotine''' was a device used for carrying out executions by decapitation. It consisted of a tall upright frame from which a blade was suspended. This blade was raised with a rope and then allowed to drop, separating the head from the body. The condemned were often led to the guillotine incorporating a public spectacle and executed in plain view, adding to the victim's degradation.<ref name="SoftWar">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref> The [[Electroguillotine/Legends|electroguillotine]] was a type of guillotine used on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="SoftWarEG">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep504|text="The Soft War" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
